description: Each coordinate of a pair preceding q in the maximum-first order is at most the maximum coordinate of q.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.InfiniteCardinalArithmetic.squareLT_predecessors.{u} {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (p q : α × α)
  (hp : Lemmatheca.Entry.InfiniteCardinalArithmetic.squareLT p q) : p.1 ≤ max q.1 q.2 ∧ p.2 ≤ max q.1 q.2
